chunks: And from his sermon (peace be upon him) regarding the purpose of the deputation and the coming time

That Allah, the Blessed and Exalted, sent His Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) to bring people out from the narrow path to the broad one, and from difficulty to ease, and from certainty to doubt.
ai.seo_question: What is the primary purpose of the Prophet's mission according to this sermon?
ai.summary: In this sermon, Imam Ali (AS) articulates the teleological purpose of the Prophetic mission as a divine transition from the narrowness of worldly constraints to the expansive freedom of spiritual certainty, a concept deeply rooted in Shia eschatology regarding the establishment of justice. Scholars note that this 'ease' (al-sa'ah) is not merely comfort but the removal of the burden of ignorance, aligning with the Shia understanding of the Prophet's role in purifying the soul and preparing humanity for the ultimate reckoning. This rhetorical contrast underscores the transformative power of divine guidance in shifting human existence from a state of existential confinement to one of liberated truth.
